name: Namaiki na Seito Kaichou no Himitsu o Abake ~Sumaho ni Virus o Shikakete Yaritai Houdai~
original_name: 生意気な生徒会長のヒミツを暴け ～スマホにウイルスを仕掛けてやりたい放題～
source:
Fuyumi, the student council president, ridicules the protagonist for being an otaku. One day, after being embarrassed in front of his class, the protagonist vowed to exact revenge on her.

He installed a virus in Fuyumi's phone, which allowed him to hack into the camera of her phone. It was developed by a friend he got acquainted with online.  

Just after he started his surveillance, he immediately got hold of a blackmail material.

Next day, he showed that recording of Fuyumi, who turned pale, and then demanded something from her...

[Translated from [url=http://pachi2.com/pro_namasma.php]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
学生会长冬美嘲笑主人公是宅男。一天，主人公在全班面前受到羞辱，发誓要向她复仇。

他在冬美的手机里安装了病毒，通过病毒黑入手机摄像头。病毒由他在网上认识的朋友开发。

开始监视后不久，他立刻掌握了一份可以勒索她的材料。

第二天，他向脸色苍白的冬美展示那段录像，随后向她提出要求……

[译自[url=http://pachi2.com/pro_namasma.php]官方网站[/url]]
